profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Typescript, Angular 12, User Interface Design, and Application Programming Interfaces.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated and communicated with management, internal, and external development partners regarding application design status, project progress, and issue resolution
- Architected and executed automated Stripe payment system on Ruby on Rails server
- Increased user acquisition by 30 percent by enhancing user dashboard UI/UX
- Cultivated 3 junior engineers’ Ruby, JavaScript, and SASS skills by providing technical mentorship and guidance through conceptual and design states of product development
- Revamped engineering technical interview by improving quality of CS questions asked which saved 30 minutes per interview

positions.title: Assistant Software Engineer Instructor
positions.description:
-Mentored dozens of engineers to produce web apps utilizing React, Angular, Node, and other technologies.
-Conducted one-on-one tutoring and mentored over 60 students on a diverse range of CS subjects including algorithms, complexity analysis, and MVC architecture 
-Directed 6 technical interviews per week to select future students, often requiring live coding and debugging assistance

projects.title: RehJeks
projects.description:
-Led front end development using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap within an AngularJS framework 
-Implemented Javascript algorithm to update NoSQL database, and dynamically re-render front end views
-Established real-time peer-to-peer connections using PubNub's API for player interaction

projects.title: Pokemon Encounter
projects.description:
Gacha-pon/Blind box strategy in mini-game application
-Cached and parsed thousands of records from external APIs into MongoDB
-Refactored MongoDB to PostgreSQL database to optimize processing speed of user queries
-Deployed application and database on Amazon AWS (EC2, RDS)
